defects.title: Dormant legacy SoulFactory Provisioner still contains placeholder provisioning logic
defects.observed_behavior: The legacy Provisioner path contains TODO/for-now/skipped-stage logic, but hardening coverage keeps it fail-closed through soulFactoryReady=false and app startup installs FullProvisioner instead.
defects.intended_behavior: Remove the dormant path or replace it with production FullProvisioner/OpenClaw wiring so no placeholder provisioning implementation can become reachable.
defects.verification_notes: Not part of the live Item 4 production path; tracked as Bead bahia-j28b during closeout.
